notes: Source: the managing company's own report (אלטשולר שחם גמל ופנסיה בע"מ, a subsidiary of the listed Altshuler Shaham Financial), as published on the company website as-invest.co.il, page 'דוחות כספיים - חברה לניהול קופות גמל - אלטשולר שחם' (https://www.as-invest.co.il/interstedin/gemel/דוחות-כספיים-אלטשולר-שחם-גמל-ופנסיה-בעמ/). The PDF is archived in data/work/lts_altshuler_a/<period>.pdf. At the time of this run the site answers automated requests with a 'Request Rejected' page (WAF); this was not worked around, the archived PDFs from the earlier download were used. MAYA was not queried (the MAYA entries in web/public/data/companies/altshuler.docs.json are the listed parent's reports). The listed parent's reports were not used: every figure comes from the managing company's report (source_entity on every fact).

Amounts in NIS thousand as printed (members = count; fee rates = percent as printed). Figures printed in parentheses are recorded negative; a dash is recorded as value null with a note. Nothing is calculated, annualised or aggregated across columns; 'total' = the printed 'סך הכל' column (provident funds + new pension funds).

Text-layer integrity: in these PDFs part of the digits in the text layer are corrupt (decimal numbers such as fee rates, many bold or total cells, and the year/date in table headings; in the 2024 quarterly reports and the 2024 annual report also some income-statement and segment cells). Every number was therefore read from the text layer and compared with an OCR of the rendered page (400 dpi, row-level and cell-level); where they differed the OCR value was adopted only if the table's arithmetic held (rows sum to totals, segment columns sum to the total column, income statement foots, ties between tables). Facts whose value came from OCR carry a 'verification' field. Fee rates (percent) were OCR-read cell by cell; the FY2023 and FY2022 rates, which appear in 5 and 2 reports respectively, are identical across reports including those where the text layer is intact. The date of each table was taken from the table order and confirmed on the rendered page headings (the heading digits in the text layer are corrupt) and, for comparative columns, by identity with the same table in the other reports.

Per-fund-type tables (business description / directors' report, 'נתונים אודות המוצרים והשירותים של החברה'): segment pension_new = new pension funds (comprehensive 'מקיפה' and general 'כללית' as separate columns, fund_type comprehensive_new_pension / general_new_pension; the company manages no veteran pension fund); provident = kupot gemel: personal gemel for compensation and severance (provident_savings_compensation), study funds (study_fund), investment gemel (investment_provident), child-savings gemel (child_savings) and 'קופות מרכזיות' (other_provident_funds: central severance funds, sick-pay fund and the central fund for participation in budget pension). sub = population (active / inactive / recipients = pension recipients / total / active_and_inactive). 'מספר עמיתים' counts accounts for the gemel funds and members for the pension funds (printed footnote). Table rows for payments to pensioners, 'אחרים' (other payments), excess income, actuarial surplus, inactive/disconnected-account tables and the 2021 merger row 'קבלת נכסים נטו לקופת גמל (מיזוג)' are printed but not recorded (outside the v7 metric list).

Windows: interim reports print year-to-date flows from 1 January (Q1 = three months, window q; Q2 and Q3 = six / nine months, window ytd) for the fund-type tables, the same date of the prior year, and the full prior year (31.12.2023, window fy). The income statement and the segment note also print three-month columns in Q2 and Q3 (window q). Stock items (members, aum) are instants.

Income statement (directors' report section 'תוצאות הפעילות', equal to the statement of comprehensive income) is recorded under segment total. general_and_administrative_expenses_incl_operating_fees = 'הוצאות הנהלה וכלליות' of the income statement and includes 'דמי תפעול' (operating fees paid to operators). In the segment note (באור מגזרי פעילות) the segments print: management fees net of refunds, selling and marketing expenses (עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות, which include amortisation of deferred acquisition costs), operating fees, 'סך כל ההוצאות המשותפות' (= the two expense lines, recorded as segment_expenses), segment profit before allocation of joint expenses (segment_profit), and in a second table the allocation of G&A (net of operating fees, recorded as general_and_administrative_expenses), other expenses and finance expenses to pension / provident / not allocated. The segment 'total' column includes the 'לא מיוחס למגזרי פעילות' column (investment income, other income, unallocated costs). For total-column lines already printed in the income statement (management fees, total revenue, S&M, other and finance expenses) the segment-note total is identical and is not repeated.

Not recorded as exact: the balance-sheet commentary of the interim reports quotes deferred acquisition cost amortisation only as an approximate figure ('כ-'); dac_amortisation is recorded only where a table prints it (annual reports, S&M note, total company).

Cross-checks run: every additive row of the fund-type tables foots (total column = sum of the fund columns; active + inactive + recipients = total); provident and new-pension management fees from assets / deposits in the tables tie to the audited fee note within rounding in the annual reports (FY2024: general pension fund 1,730 / 2,316 in the table vs 1,713 / 2,333 in the note, a 17 reclassification between assets and deposits fees, both as printed); income statement foots; segment columns foot; G&A (income statement) = G&A net of operating fees + operating fees; pension + provident = total for S&M and management fees; every date that appears in more than one report has identical values in all of them.

The 2022 comparative table of fund-type data in this report prints its three 'results' rows in a different order than the 2023 annual report (labels: 'קבלת נכסים נטו (מיזוג)' 1,562,130, 'דמי גמולים משונתים' 16,342,278, 'תקבולים מדמי גמולים' 1,649,707); the 2023 annual report prints new-joiner annualised deposits 1,562,130 and deposits 16,342,278 for 2022. The two rows new_business_annualized_premiums and deposits for 2022 are therefore NOT recorded from this report (use the 2023FY file); all other 2022 rows agree with the 2023 report.
